title: First COVID-19 case in Türkiye
description: Pandemic measures followed in spring 2020; check the consumption dip in the data.

title: Consumption series includes unmetered generation
description: Observed in data: from 30 Dec 2020 real-time consumption exceeds metered generation plus net imports by about 3% (rising to about 10% in 2026); before that the two match to within 0.1%. Growth rates across this date are overstated. No public EPİAŞ announcement found in a web search on 13 Oct 2026; ask EPİAŞ and compare with YEKDEM unlicensed generation (ren-ul-gen).

title: Price cap 2,500 TL/MWh
description: TSKB energy bulletin March 2022: day-ahead and balancing maximum raised to 2,500 TL/MWh from 1 Apr 2022 for six months. Before this the limit followed a rule (see README).

title: Price cap 2,750 TL/MWh
description: Ekonomim names a 18 May 2022 board decision at 2,750; first price at 2,750 in the data is 20 May. Publication date not confirmed.

title: Price cap 3,200 TL/MWh
description: AA, 28 May 2022: raised to 3,200. First price at 3,200 in the data is 1 Jun, so the first affected delivery day is shown.

title: Price cap 3,750 TL/MWh
description: Ekonomim, 30 Jun 2022: raised from 3,200 to 3,750, in force from 1 Jul.

title: Price cap 4,000 TL/MWh
description: Observed in data only: 4,000 first reached on 1 Aug 2022. No decision found.

title: Price cap 4,800 TL/MWh
description: Finansopia, 1 Sep 2022: raised to 4,800, in force on publication. First price at 4,800 is 2 Sep.

title: Price cap 4,200 TL/MWh
description: Observed in data only: 4,200 from 1 Jan 2023. Capital (30 Mar 2023) lists 4,200 as the level before February.

title: Price cap 3,650 TL/MWh
description: Capital, 30 Mar 2023: 4,200 in January, 3,650 in February.

title: Kahramanmaraş earthquakes
description: Earthquakes in southeastern Türkiye; effects on demand and on the grid in the affected region.

title: Price cap 3,050 TL/MWh
description: Dünya, 1 Mar 2023: lowered from 3,650 to 3,050, published in the Official Gazette.

title: Price cap 2,600 TL/MWh
description: TSKB energy bulletin March 2023: cut from 3,050 to 2,600 from 1 Apr 2023.

title: Price cap 2,700 TL/MWh
description: BloombergHT, 4 Jul 2023: board decision of 3 Jul 2023 sets the maximum at 2,700 (from 2,600). Effective date taken as the publication day; 2,700 is first seen in the data on 20 Jul.

title: Price cap 3,000 TL/MWh
description: Observed in data only: 3,000 from 1 Jul 2024. No decision found.

title: Price cap 3,400 TL/MWh
description: AA, 5 Apr 2025: raised from 3,000 to 3,400, in force 5 Apr.

title: Very high hydro output
description: Observed in data: dam hydro 8-9 TWh a month in Mar-May 2026 against 3-5.5 TWh in the springs of 2023-2025; PTF averaged 591 TL/MWh in May 2026. Confirm with precipitation and reservoir data.

title: Price cap 4,500 TL/MWh
description: CNBC-e, 3 Apr 2026: limits of 0 and 4,500 published in the Official Gazette, in force 4 Apr.
